parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.1.1.1/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family inet address 10.1.2.1/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit

set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.command: set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address 4.4.4.4/32
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.explanation: 配置环回接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set protocols pim interface ge-0/0/0.0 s.command: set protocols pim interface ge-0/0/0.0 sparse-mode
set protocols pim interface ge-0/0/0.0 s.explanation: 在指定接口上启用稀疏模式的PIM。

set protocols pim interface ge-0/0/1.0 s.command: set protocols pim interface ge-0/0/1.0 sparse-mode
set protocols pim interface ge-0/0/1.0 s.explanation: 在指定接口上启用稀疏模式的PIM。

set protocols pim interface lo0.0 sparse.command: set protocols pim interface lo0.0 sparse-mode
set protocols pim interface lo0.0 sparse.explanation: 在环回接口上启用稀疏模式的PIM。

set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interfac.command: set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface ge-0/0/0.0
set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interfac.explanation: 将接口加入到OSPF的指定区域中。

set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interfac.command: set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface ge-0/0/1.0
set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interfac.explanation: 将接口加入到OSPF的指定区域中。

set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interfac.command: set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface lo0.0
set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interfac.explanation: 将环回接口加入到OSPF的指定区域中。
